Enterprise Architecture • Complete Data Sovereignty

Enterprise Bring-Your-Own-Database (BYOD) & Webhook Integrations

Maintain 100% data residency and sovereign compliance. Connect your private AWS RDS or on-premise PostgreSQL database with RealSalePro's high-speed application runtime without sacrificing cloud software flexibility.

100% Data Ownership

You retain full legal and physical ownership of all buyer leads, site visit logs, and transaction details. RealSalePro acts strictly as a stateless client application.

Enhanced Security

Your database sits behind your corporate VPC and firewalls. Access is strictly granted to our dedicated static cluster IP addresses via TLS 1.3.

DPDP Act Compliance

Ideal for regulated real estate developers requiring strict data localization within India under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act of 2023.

Incentive Automation

Unlocks dynamic custom commission calculation engines and automated incentive disbursement workflows across your sales hierarchy.

Simple 3-Step Integration Workflow

1

Setup Database

Provision a dedicated PostgreSQL (v12+) instance on your choice of cloud provider (AWS RDS, EC2, or Hostinger VPS).

2

Whitelist Static IP

Configure your VPC security group or server firewall to accept encrypted connections only from RealSalePro application cluster IPs.

3

Connect & Handshake

Provide connection credentials in your RealSalePro admin settings. Our runtime initializes schema tables automatically within seconds.
